function.name: EventQuery
function.description: Search for calendar events that match a given text query within a user's calendar. The search considers both the title and description of the events. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

search_string.description: The text to search for within the title and description of an event.

start_date.description: The start date for the range of events to search, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the range of events to search, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

include_recurring.description: A flag to indicate whether to include recurring events in the search.

function.name: reschedule_event
function.description: Reschedule an event by assigning it a new date or time based on the provided ISO-8601 datetime string. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_identifier.description: A unique identifier for the event, such as a UUID.

new_datetime.description: The new date and time to which the event is being rescheduled, in ISO-8601 format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ').

message.content:
Sure thing! To set up your next gym session I just need a few quick details:

| Detail | Question |
|--------|----------|
| **Date & Time** | When would you like to hit the gym? If you're not sure, let me know a preferred weekday or time window (morning/afternoon/evening). |
| **Duration** | How long will each workout last? (Typical sessions run from 45 min–90 min.) |
| **Location / Gym Name** | Which facility or home‑workout routine will you use? |
| **Frequency** | Is this a one‑off session or part of a regular weekly plan? |

Once I have those pieces, I'll add the event to your calendar right away—complete with reminders so you never miss a sweat sesh. Let me know how you'd like to proceed!
message.reasoning:
The user says "Schedule my next gym session". We need to schedule a gym session. But we don't have context about their calendar. There's no mention of existing events. They want us to create a new event? Or find the next available slot? Usually scheduling means creating a new event.

We can ask clarifying question: when do they want to schedule? What day/time? Duration? Location?

But maybe we should interpret this as "schedule your next gym session" meaning add a new event titled "Gym Session" at some default times like tomorrow morning? That seems risky; better to clarify with them first.

Thus respond asking details: what date/time would you prefer? duration? location? Also confirm if they'd like reminders etc.
